card.name: Needle-draw pain description wording
card.fires_on: Words in the stock sentence about how a blood draw will feel, such as 'will', 'may', 'slight' and 'moderate' right before 'feel' or 'pain'. It is strongest in the 'How the test will feel' passage.

modes.description: Words inside the sentences describing pain or stinging when a needle is inserted.
